item.title: Enhanced deduction for seniors
item.description: Taxpayers who are 65 and older by the end of the taxable year can claim a personal exemption for the 2025 through 2028 taxable years deduction up to $6,000. The $6,000 deduction amount is not adjusted for inflation. Married taxpayers can claim the $6,000 personal exemption deduction for each spouse who is age 65 or older. Married taxpayers can only claim the deduction if they file a joint return....
